My Daily Walk Story

Introduction

I have extracted the data about my personal daily walk with some factors through the Google Form. This is recorded with number of steps, weather condition, purpose of walk, and time of days. The aim to gather the data is to see how these factors affect on the average daily number of walk I take each day.

How does the weather affect on my daily walk?

bar chart showing sunny days have the highest average daily steps and cloudy days the lowest

The plot 1 above shows the relationship between the weather and my average personal daily walk. When the weather is sunny, the average walk is the highest, which is approximately 7000 steps. When the weather is cloudy, the average walk is the lowest, which is approximately 4700 steps.

What is my daily purpose of walk?

The plot 2 above shows the relationship between the purpose of walk and my average personal daily walk. When the purpose of walk is entertainment, the average walk is the highest, which is approximately 9000 steps. When the purpose of walk is home, the average walk is the lowest, which is approximately 1000 steps.

My Daily Steps Taken by Time of Day

The plot 3 above shows the relationship between time of day and my average personal daily walk. When the time is afternoon (between 12pm and 5pm), the average walk is the highest, which is approximately 12500 steps. When the time is morning, the average walk is the lowest, which is recorded as few as 0 steps.
